LanguageData.MS_Shelf_CopyPresetDesc: Copy this shelf's mode, cooling setting, items, per-slot restocking limits, filters, restocking warnings and priority.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_LowTemperatureModeDesc: Lower the temperature of items on this shelf by 100°C, down to −10°C. Already colder items keep their original temperature. Requires no power or network connection. Items may still rot in extreme heat.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_PastePresetDesc: Apply the copied preset to the selected restocking shelves, replacing their current settings. Supports multiple selected shelves.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_ConfigureDesc: Choose an item and restocking limit for each of the {0} slots. Slots may hold the same item type.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_PriorityHint: Colonists will not haul items into this shelf; only the connected storage network provides restocking.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_LimitTip: Restock quantity limit: 0–{0}. Lowering the limit keeps existing stock.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_RecallTip: Return every item on this shelf to the storage network now. Items that cannot be returned stay on the shelf and are handled by normal restocking and cleanup.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Use: Colonists can take items directly. Restocks automatically; does not accept normal hauling.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_PickHint: Expand categories or search, then click an item to select it. Each slot holds one item type. Multiple slots may select the same item.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_AlreadySelected: This item is already assigned to another slot.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_FilterHint: Restock only items matching the quality, condition and material filters. Rejected stock returns to the network where possible, or is placed nearby.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_WarnOnFailureTip: Show an alert on the right side of the screen when a restocking attempt cannot reach the configured quantity.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_AlertExplanation: These slots have restocking warnings enabled and could not reach their configured quantities.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_FilterMismatch: No stock matches the quality, condition or material filters
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_ReservedStock: Required stock is reserved by another task and temporarily unavailable
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_IncompatibleStack: Remaining stock cannot stack with the items on the shelf
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_NetworkUnavailable: The storage network cannot operate; check the core and connections
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_NoSpace: No free shelf space, or items cannot be placed in its cell
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_PlacementFailed: Items could not be placed on the shelf
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_Burning: The shelf cell is on fire and cannot be restocked
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_FilterModeDesc: Use a shared storage filter with separate stack limits for each slot. Switching modes returns shelf contents to the core first; switching is blocked if any item cannot be returned.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_QuickFoodDesc: Switch to filter mode and set the shared filter to allow all foods. If the mode cannot be changed, keep the existing filter.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_SharedFilterHint: All slots share this filter and restock to their own limits. Empty slots take the first matching available item in the network inventory list.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_DistinctItemsTip: When restocking empty slots, skip item types already on this shelf and select the next available type. Different materials or qualities of the same item still count as one type. Existing stacks are topped up normally, and duplicates are kept.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_SharedLimitTip: Controls only this slot. The item's own stack limit also applies. Set to 0 to pause restocking. Lowering the limit keeps existing stock.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_ModeBlocked: Some shelf contents could not be returned to the core. The current mode is unchanged. Check the network connection, core storage filter and remaining capacity, and ensure the items are not forbidden or reserved.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_LocalPresetsDesc: Save shelf settings locally, or load and delete saved presets. Presets remain available after restarting the game or changing saves.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_LocalPresetsHint: Enter a name to save this shelf's settings. Loading replaces the current settings. Saving an existing name asks before overwriting.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_OverwritePresetConfirm: A preset named "{0}" already exists. Replace it with this shelf's current settings?
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_MissingPresetItems: Some items in this preset are not available in the currently loaded game and mods. The loaded settings may differ from your expectations.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_PresetFileError: Unable to read or write the local preset file: {0}
